note: Issue 388, patrons.md section 7. One file serves every patron: the director reads a sender that names no contact as a role and expands it to one candidate per man holding it, each with his own context, so {sender:name} and {sender:specialty} are this patron's and not a template's. It establishes the correspondence and nothing else - which is the whole of its job, because a reply produces an Order addressed to the sender and that is the first thing in the game that can bank patron credit. Both answers are materially free; what they cost is his regard, which prestige.md section 2 already makes a live term.

body.text: {sender:name}, at your service, though we have not met and you have no particular reason to want me.
I have been following your colony's fortunes with rather more attention than is quite decent. A man at court must take an interest in something, and I have grown tired of horses.

I will not pretend to disinterest. I have {sender:specialty} to spare and a use for {sender:need}, and I would sooner deal with a man I have written to than one I have not. You will find I am reasonable and that I remember things.
I will not pretend to disinterest. I have {sender:specialty} to spare and a use for {sender:need}, and I am told you are difficult, which I mention so that neither of us is surprised later.
Write back or do not. I shall draw my own conclusions either way, and I am afraid I shall share them.
